entities.name: Embercleave
entities.description: A legendary magical sword of Eldraine, once an ordinary knight's sword named by the Irencrag.

entities.name: Irencrag
entities.description: Crag beside the Burning Yard that speaks to worthy knights and names their swords.

entities.name: Burning Yard
entities.description: Massive volcanic-hot boulder where knights of Embereth test their courage.

entities.name: Knights of Embereth
entities.description: Knights who must plunge their sword into the Burning Yard.

entities.name: Ianthe
entities.description: Said to be the first to impale the stone with her sword.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion that saw the fall of the Courts.

events.summary: Ianthe is inspired by the Irencrag's taunts to be the first to impale the stone with her sword.
events.quote: this taunting inspired Ianthe to be the first to impale the stone with her sword

events.summary: The Irencrag bestows a legendary name on a worthy knight's sword, creating the Embercleave.
events.quote: This led to the creation of the Embercleave.

relations.note: bestowed a legendary name and power
relations.quote: it will bestow their sword with a legendary name, forever imbuing it with its power
